beat1_summary: A quieter month than July on the surface, and a stronger one underneath. Reach came back to earth after the flood post, but people watched more than half of every Reel and clicked through at nearly twice July’s rate.
work_chips: Themes: sandwich craft, the counter staff, catering
Focus: holding attention past three seconds
beat2_prose: We tightened the opening of every Reel and led with the food itself instead of the setup. Fewer posts than July, built to be watched all the way through rather than scrolled past.
beat3_takeaway: July’s flood post brought a crowd. August proved they stayed: people watched more than half of every Reel, and clicked through at nearly double July’s rate.
beat4_takeaway: The posts that traveled were the ones with your people in them. The sisters, the staff, the regulars behind the counter.
beat5_takeaway: September is about giving people a reason to save. Reach and clicks are strong, so the one gap left is content worth keeping.
beat2_takeaway: We published 13 pieces in August, 11 Reels and two carousels, every one of them built to earn the first three seconds.
